features.name: 100 Bishopsgate
features.official_source_evidence: The official building domain is retained but currently presents an automated verification page. Published building records identify a 40-storey development with 32 office floors and a secondary restaurant-and-office building.
features.classification_finding: Office Building is strongly supported, but the source snapshot and exact tower footprint remain pending.

features.name: Kew Palace / Dutch House
features.official_source_evidence: Historic Royal Palaces identifies the asset as Kew Palace and documents royal rooms, bedrooms, drawing rooms, kitchens and palace history.
features.classification_finding: The tracked Detached Home category is not a clean semantic match for a royal palace. Preserve the row but require a documented category-policy decision before publication as Detached Home.

features.name: Ryton industrial / distribution site
features.official_source_evidence: No sufficiently specific current official unit source was confirmed in this research pass. Public records describe the former vehicle-plant site, later Network Rail distribution use and multiple subsequent site uses.
features.classification_finding: The row names a broad historical industrial site rather than one verified Industrial Unit. A current operator and specific building must be selected before source upgrade or geometry binding.

features.name: Standen House and Garden
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies Standen as an Arts and Crafts family home and house with a defined visitor-property identity.
features.classification_finding: Detached Home is supported at the broad product-category level; the principal house footprint must remain separate from gardens and ancillary buildings.

features.classification_finding: Retail Property is strongly supported; exact shopping-centre and parcel boundaries remain pending.
